summary: Frontend-only end-to-end testing of Phase-1 AI-assisted Bank Transaction Inbox at /bank-transactions. All 13 scenarios from the review request passed: admin sidebar navigation, all 7 tabs render with counts, manual ingest via ManualBankTxnDialog (Claude AI classification completed within ~15-20s), duplicate detection (Duplicates tab shows duplicate-info banner), Explain dialog (reasons + historical-matches-table), Audit dialog (2 audit-row entries per new txn), Edit dialog with modified-tag chips, original-suggestion preview, populated account (38) + project (108) selects, Approve & Post creating a matching Finance transaction (verified via /transactions page containing edited notes), Reject via window.prompt with page.on('dialog') handler moves card to Rejected tab with rejection-reason line, filters (direction/type/confidence/search/reset) and view-table toggle work, Mapping Rules tab shows 3 learned rules with edit/save/toggle interactions, Ingestion History tab shows 100 rows, direct browser refresh on /bank-transactions preserves route (SPA), and regression smoke on Dashboard, Transactions and Data Migration all load cleanly.

issues: Recharts warning: 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' — pre-existing chart container initial-render warning (does not break UI). Consider setting minWidth/minHeight on the ResponsiveContainer.

critical_code_review_comments: BankTxnCard reject() uses window.prompt — works but blocks other UI and is not testable via standard modal selectors; consider a proper dialog with data-testid='reject-reason-input' + confirm button for consistency with Edit/Approve flows.
MappingRulesTab rule-delete-btn uses window.confirm — same UX concern as above.
IngestionHistoryTab returns 100 rows with no pagination/limit control in the UI (server likely caps it). If ingestion volume grows this list can bloat.
BankTransactions.jsx load() swallows errors silently (catch { /* ignore */ }) — users won't see API failures on the inbox listing. Consider toast.error on load failures.

ManualBankTxnDialog does not disable submit while classification is running server-side beyond the local 'saving' flag; ok because dialog closes immediately, but the toast for AI-classified vs duplicate is the only feedback (worked correctly).
seed_data_creation: Created 2 QA Bank transactions via manual-bank-btn during test (1 approved + posted to Finance, 1 rejected). Also submitted a 3rd duplicate attempt. bank_name='QA Bank' as instructed for identifiability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All testids validated: nav-bank-transactions, tab-{pending,approved,rejected,duplicate,all,rules,history}, manual-bank-btn, manual-bank-dialog, manual-{bank,account,date,time,direction,amount,narration,reference,utr}, manual-submit, bank-txn-card-{id}, card-{explain,audit,edit,reject,approve,reclassify}-btn, card-match-count, card-bank-name, card-amount, card-narration, duplicate-info, explain-dialog, explain-reasons, historical-matches-table, audit-dialog, audit-row, bank-edit-dialog, bank-edit-{type,account,project,amount,date,notes}, bank-edit-save, original-suggestion, modified-tag, original-suggestion-line, finance-link, rejection-reason, bank-filters, filter-{search,bank,direction,type,account,project,start,end,min-amount,max-amount,confidence,reset}, view-cards, view-table, bank-table-view, mapping-rules-tab, rule-row-{id}, rule-{edit,save,cancel,toggle,delete}-btn, rules-empty (only when 0 rules), ingestion-history-tab, ingestion-row. Reject uses window.prompt — use page.once('dialog', lambda d: d.accept('reason')) BEFORE clicking card-reject-btn. AI classification via Claude takes 10-20s on manual ingest — sleep at least 15s before asserting card visibility. Meta endpoint /api/meta returns accounts (38) and project_ids (108) that populate all select dropdowns.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs found. All 13 review-request scenarios passed end-to-end.
